title: A bounded above complex whose cohomology is pseudo-coherent degree by degree is pseudo-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a bounded above complex with cohomology modules that are pseudo-coherent with a degree shift is itself m-pseudo-coherent, and similarly in the unbounded-degree pseudo-coherent case. The proof is an induction on the top degree in which cohomology is nonzero: below the bounding degree the statement follows from the characterisation of m-pseudo-coherence, and above it the author uses the distinguished triangle relating the truncation, the complex, and the top cohomology module shifted into its degree. The shifted cohomology is m-pseudo-coherent by hypothesis, so the cone lemma reduces the claim to the truncation, which is handled by the induction hypothesis, with the pseudo-coherent case recovered from the m-pseudo-coherent case and the characterisation.
